full_name: Margot Livesey | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Fiction & Poetry Evelyn Green Davis Fellow Emerson College
bio: Margot Livesey is a novelist who teaches at Emerson College in Boston. She published her seventh novel, The Flight of Gemma Hardy: A Novel (Harper), in February 2012.
